verification.note: frontend/src/components/FileDetail/hooks/useFileDetailData.ts:187-191: the catch toasts subtitleFailure(err, te) when it returns a message, calls console.error, and does not rethrow, so the promise resolves. In frontend/src/components/markdown/EditableTitle.tsx:65-70, commit() awaits onRename and then calls setEditing(false). It sets its error icon only when onRename rejects. The field therefore closes as though the rename succeeded. One detail is wrong: the old name does not wait for a reload to come back. setFile is never called on failure, so the title prop stays the old name, and the effect at EditableTitle.tsx:44-46 resets the value as soon as editing ends. The old name shows at once. onRename is wired only to MarkdownDocumentLayout (ShellLayout.tsx:741), so this path covers documents and notes, not videos.

addons/knowledge/.github/workflows/ci.yml:147 and :243 read `node-version: 24` under actions/setup-node@v4, at the hunk positions given. Without git I could not see the earlier value 20. The touch points name only Editor.tsx and messages/{ja,en}.json in the knowledge repository. The r6 triage (r6/triage.md:228-265) lists this as claude-deep:F4 and claude-read:CR-2, bucket B and still open, and nothing in the r7 tree changes it.

useFileDetailData.ts:187-191: there is no rethrow, so EditableTitle.tsx:66-67 closes the field. A non-subtitle failure, where subtitleFailure returns null (subtitleErrors.ts:69-71), only reaches console.error, so nothing is shown to the user. The silent non-subtitle path looks pre-existing; r6 triage records the same catch as pre-existing. Subtitle refusals now get a translated toast that names the files, so the I11 message requirement holds for this entry point. The field-closing behavior is a UX defect, not a broken invariant.

unspecified_scores.reason: Every rename, move or copy of a video or .loft now does an extra directory listing and row query. On a home LAN this costs a few milliseconds that the user does not notice.

An upload of subtitles only, into a new nested relative_path, tracks only the deepest folder as an EmptyFolder (_ensure_empty_folder_tracked, fileops.py:146). An intermediate folder may stay unlisted until a scan if the listing does not derive ancestors.
Renaming a note from its page title to a subtitle extension is refused. The field closes showing the old name, and the explanation appears only in a toast, not inline at the field.
Every video rename or move lists the source and destination folders on disk and queries their rows. The cost is small and the user does not notice it.

specification_compliance: 185.8 lists the file page's title rename as an entry point. A subtitle refusal there now shows a translated toast that names the files (useFileDetailData.ts:188-189), which meets I11's message requirement, but the title field still closes as on success.
The knowledge gitlink still carries an unrelated CI Node version change that is not in the touch points.
regression_risks: If the rename catch is changed to rethrow, EditableTitle will show err.message in its error icon tooltip. The ApiStatusError message may be untranslated unless the rethrown error carries the translated text.
test_coverage: I did not find a test that asserts EditableTitle keeps the field open on a refused rename from the file page.
not_verified: The previous node-version value in addons/knowledge ci.yml: I had no git access and saw only the current value 24.
Whether the folder listing derives intermediate ancestors from EmptyFolder paths, which decides whether the nested-folder behavior is visible.
I did not trace how ApiStatusError is constructed from rename responses beyond subtitleFailure.
